name: HRT-Recorder
subtitle: HRT doses, labs & trends
promotionalText: Private HRT tracking for doses, lab results, reminders and estimated E2/T trends—with Siri, Shortcuts, widgets and Apple Watch. No account, ads or tracking.
description:
Keep your HRT timeline in one private place.

HRT Recorder helps you record medication events, lab results, reminders, and estimated estradiol or testosterone trends. It works without an account and keeps your records on your devices.

KEY FEATURES
• Record estradiol and testosterone across injections, patches, gels, oral and sublingual routes.
• Keep record-only anti-androgen reminders alongside your timeline.
• Review estimated PK curves, AUC, and trends with a smooth, adaptive chart.
• Scan hormone lab reports on device, preserve the original value and unit, and convert eligible E2/T results for calibration.
• Log doses with Siri and Shortcuts, widgets, or Apple Watch.
• Create medication plans and local reminders.
• Optionally read supported medications and body weight from the Health app, and write body weight when you choose.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No sign-in, advertising, or third-party analytics. HRT Recorder does not run a developer-operated data server. Health data is accessed only with your permission.

IMPORTANT
PK curves and calibrated values are informational estimates. HRT Recorder does not diagnose conditions, recommend treatment, calculate a prescribed dose, or replace a qualified clinician. Check with a healthcare professional before making medical decisions. Not for emergencies.
whatsNew:
• Record doses with Siri and Shortcuts, with clearer follow-up and confirmation.
• On supported devices running iOS 27 with Apple Intelligence available, Apple’s on-device Foundation Models help understand natural-language dose-recording requests and hormone lab reports. Data for these features is processed entirely on device.
• Choose an Estradiol (E2) or Testosterone (T) HRT profile for dosing, curves, and calibration.
• Improved lab report scanning preserves source values and units, and only converts eligible E2/T results for calibration.
• Smoother timelines with adaptive Y-axis scaling, animated range changes, stable cursor callouts, and better scrolling performance.
• Clearer widgets with a configurable before/after time range.
• Refined system-style UI, dark/light mode fixes, and compatibility improvements for iOS 18 and newer.
• Added French, German, Spanish, Japanese, Korean, and Thai; expanded Simplified and Traditional Chinese.
